returns.major: The major version of the policy.
returns.minor: The minor version of the policy.

returns.permissions: - Array of keycodes and function selectors for requested permissions.

params.tokensToTransfer: list of tokens to transfer back to treasury (i.e. reserves)

VERSION().notice: Returns the version of the policy.

adjustNextYield(uint256).notice: allow manager to increase (by maximum 10%) or decrease yield for week if contract is inaccurate

changeKernel(address).notice: Function used by kernel when migrating to a new kernel.

configureDependencies().notice: Define module dependencies for this policy.

endEpoch().notice: create a new bond market at the end of the day with some portion of remaining funds

getNextYield().notice: compute yield for the next week

getReserveBalance().notice: fetch combined sReserve balance of active clearinghouses and treasury, in reserve

isActive().notice: Easily accessible indicator for if a policy is activated or not.

isShutdown().notice: Returns whether the contract is shutdown

requestPermissions().notice: Function called by kernel to set module function permissions.

shutdown(address[]).notice: retire contract by burning ohm balance and transferring tokens to treasury

userdoc.notice: the Yield Repurchase Facility (Yield Repo) contract pulls a derived amount of yield from         the Olympus treasury each week and uses it, along with the backing of previously purchased         OHM, to purchase OHM off the market using a Bond Protocol SDA market.
